album: Spotify & Live Nation are turning your streaming habits into concert ticket access with 'Reserved'
excerpt: Your daily streaming habits could soon get you closer to seeing your favourite artists live. Spotify and Live Nation have announced Reserved by Spotify , a new ticket access programme that rewards top listeners with early access to select concerts before tickets go on sale to the public. Launching first in the United States this summer, the initiative uses fan engagement signals including streams, shares, and listening activity to identify listeners eligible for a dedicated ticket access window.
